video_title: ROOMMATES SHOW LIVE PT. 2 🍎 Spike Lee, Jimmy Fallon and the Wives Share Knicks' Playoff Run Stories

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on the power of sports to unite New York City
quotes.excerpt: Sports brings people together. And New York City was together.
quotes.quote: Here is the thing about sports. Sports brings people together. And New York City was together. It is amazing, hugging, toes, strangers. And if you just want to keep, keep going, quick, just say, 'Knicks in 5' and keep going. It is not a conversation. 'Knicks in 5', 'Knicks in 5', boom, boom, boom, and it is all love. And so, thank you for bringing New York City together. Sports is one of the few things that can do that.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on his long-term commitment as a Knicks season ticket holder
quotes.excerpt: I have been a season ticket holder since Pat Ewing's rookie year.
quotes.quote: I have been a season ticket holder since Pat Ewing's rookie year. But I was not courtside though. So every year, back then, the Garden, every section had a different color. So I started in green, then I moved down to yellow and orange. Then I got the word from someone who worked in the Garden, said, 'Spike, because they gave away those tickets, you could not buy them.' I got the inside word they are going on sale, so I got it.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the intensity of playing at Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: I have been a part of some loud moments in the Garden.
quotes.quote: In my four years here, I have been a part of some loud moments in the Garden. I have been a part of Dante's three. I have been a part of the night where I first became an All-Star. That night was loud. Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Finals this year was loud as hell. But when people actually say, 'The Garden was shaking,' like, yeah, you hear that all the time, but Game 4 of the Finals, the Garden was literally, I sat down in my seat and it felt like it was like a massage chair. It felt like it was moving.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the importance of staying healthy for Knicks games
quotes.excerpt: You wanted to be healthy against the Knicks in the Garden.
quotes.quote: No matter what team you were on, you wanted to be healthy against the Knicks in the Garden. That was the one game that you look on the calendar and you are like, 'You got to make sure you are healthy for playing in the Garden.' And exactly, for me, it was super dope because, like Jalen said, there are so many moments that the Garden is rocking. But I think it is so cool because you have the passion and the love of the fans and then you have people sitting courtside, the celebrities sitting courtside, and they go crazy.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on the Knicks' work ethic and ability to overcome adversity
quotes.excerpt: They show us what we can do, what we can overcome.
quotes.quote: Go to work. Hard work. Got to work, got to work. I mean, you live in New York, you got to work. And those guys, they show us what we can do, what we can overcome. One of them games, I was like, there is a shot of me, one of them clips, I am like this. I am not going to lie, what was it, down by 29? I was like, 'Damn.' But I did not give up though. But I was praying. In fact, I got some of these championship rings here, red host's ring, and I had them in my hand, the Knicks like this, I was praying, but the rings were inside my hand.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee wants the 76ers to watch the Knicks win from the locker room
quotes.excerpt: I don't want the 76ers in the motherfucking locker room. I want them to see the flag raised.
quotes.quote: I hope the 76ers watch, I don't want the 76ers in the motherfucking locker room. I want them to see the flag raised. LeBron can watch that, I think. He is going to watch that.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the possibility of a Spike Lee movie
quotes.excerpt: Has to be the right role.
quotes.quote: Has to be the right role. And I am not doing a sequel to 'He Got Game'. Every player in the league has asked me about that, not doing it.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson clarifies the 'player-only meeting' rumor
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't a player-only meeting. I quickly said my piece and then Mike walked in.
quotes.quote: It wasn't a player-only meeting. Before the coaches walk into the locker room after the game, I quickly said my piece and then Mike walked in. It wasn't like I said, 'We need to meet for an hour.' No, I said, 'No, I have a couple minutes to say what I have to say.' I said what I said, Mike came in, said what he had to say, and we moved on.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the turning point of the Knicks' season
quotes.excerpt: The part that defines us the most is when we were Game 4.
quotes.quote: The turning point, honestly, I joke around with Josh all the time, but I said this after the game, the part that defines us the most is when we were Game 4. We say it all the time, Josh missed a layup, 'Ha ha ha, yeah, funny.' But there was a foul and Josh is like on the ground, his head was in his hand, and me, Cat, and Jose ran up to him and said, 'Yo, get the hell up, we are good, move on, move on.' And Josh moved on. And Josh got a key stop later that in a couple of possessions later.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks' loss to the Pacers
quotes.excerpt: Nothing that we did beat them. They beat themselves.
quotes.quote: Nothing that we did beat them. They beat themselves. They just didn't play their best. You know?

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: He's probably the reason we won, honestly.
quotes.quote: He's probably the reason we won, honestly. Cursed everyone else besides us, all the way to the championship. So, we owe him a lot. We owe him a lot. And for you that I know you don't really know, Danhausen is a wrestler in WWE, and he put a curse on everybody but us, and we won the championship.

quotes.speaker: James Winston
quotes.summary_phrase: James Winston asks how the Knicks built their winning culture
quotes.excerpt: How did you be able to create take that vibrational frequency that you guys had at Villanova?
quotes.quote: How did you be able to create take that vibrational frequency that you guys had at Villanova and carry it on to win a freaking NBA Finals for the New York Knicks? I want to know that, man, because you two guys are a man of increase, and I just want to know how did you carry that vibrational frequency and what did it take for you to instill those qualities in the teammates around you?

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the Knicks' brotherhood and shared adversity
quotes.excerpt: We love each other as brothers first and teammates second.
quotes.quote: I think all of the adversity that we went through for what those four years, the last couple of years, like it all, we love each other as brothers first and teammates second. And I think when you have a bond with people that you forge through tough times and adversity and the dog days, it carries on for a lifetime. So whether it is 5, 10 years down the road, or 50 years down the road, we are going to have that relationship and that friendship always. And now we have two common championships in counting, NCAA, because I only got one, I only got one, you got two, and then we got the NBA championship, man.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on OG Anunoby's sacrifice for the team
quotes.excerpt: He was willing to sacrifice his own individual performances and his own individual accolades.
quotes.quote: He was in Brooklyn, he was the number one option, he was hooping, he was had all the play calls for him, and then he he comes over to the Knicks with a trade package that obviously he didn't ask for and it was a tall order and he was willing to sacrifice his own individual performances and his own individual accolades and those kind of things for the betterment of the team. And I feel like he really was with Landry at the core of that that word sacrifice that we really needed to win this thing. So I really want to give him love and highlight him because we've asked him to sacrifice more than anybody else on the roster.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Fallon on his experience as a Knicks fan
quotes.excerpt: I'm honored to be here. I'm a big fan of the show.
quotes.quote: I'm honored to be here. I'm a big fan of the show, and I want to get into all this stuff. This is this is cool, man. This is great to come out. Great night in New York, and I'm I'm psyched to be here.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Fallon on the 'Gobstomper' sneaker collaboration
quotes.excerpt: This is a sneaker that that I invented called the Gobstomper.
quotes.quote: This is a sneaker that that I invented called the Gobstomper. And it came out, it's my name's on it, they made 500 of these. And my idea was like, it's like a gobstopper candy. The more you wear it, the more it wears down and there's six different layers of leather underneath that, so it changes color. And it was I thought it was a great idea for a sneaker. Turns out you really got to really either probably fall out of a moving vehicle to have anything happen to this sneaker or else you're just sitting with dirty white sneakers.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Fallon on his pre-show routine and focus
quotes.excerpt: I want to go out and give a good show for everybody.
quotes.quote: I want to go out and give a good show for everybody. I practice cue cards and reading all my lines all that. I want to make sure our guests have a good time. I shower before every show. Thank you for clapping, sir. One guy is like, 'Yeah, showering,' he loves it. But yeah, I just make sure that I'm sharp. I want people to have a good time when they come on the show. We're lucky to have a great guest on the show. I have to thank you again. I want to thank Leon Rose. I want to thank Jim Dolan. I want to thank you guys for coming. You were the first we did the first show before you even did the ticker tape parade. We booked you guys with like 32 hours notice.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Fallon on the Knicks' playoff run and the team's impact
quotes.excerpt: Thank you for the gift of giving us that championship, that win, that memory.
quotes.quote: I want to say on behalf of all these Knicks fans out here, thank you for the gift of giving us that championship, that win, that memory. That memory will be with us forever. We'll tell that story forever, and we we got to thank you. I don't know if you know how much it means to us that you won and did what you did. It's amazing. You play with your heart and your soul for the best city in the world, New York, and you showed up and you crushed it. We're so proud of you. We love you, and it just made everyone so happy all across the city.
